text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"The retrieved passages do not directly answer whether intermittent fasting is effective for weight loss in older adults compared with continuous calorie restriction.","cited_pids":[]},{"cid":"c2","text":"A review of the neurotrophic effects of intermittent fasting, calorie restriction and exercise is the closest material retrieved.","cited_pids":["d5e2c7e6914b#2"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"The review summarises literature on healthier aging, neurodegenerative risk and cognitive function rather than body weight outcomes.","cited_pids":["d5e2c7e6914b#2"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"Intermittent fasting and calorie restriction are studied for neuroprotection and synaptic plasticity through metabolic switching to ketone bodies.","cited_pids":["d5e2c7e6914b#0"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"The review describes about 30 literature reviews on these interventions.","cited_pids":["d5e2c7e6914b#1"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"As summarised, the retrieved review does not report a head-to-head weight loss comparison in older adults.","cited_pids":["d5e2c7e6914b#1"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"One retrieved passage concerns tuberculosis trials and is unrelated to fasting.","cited_pids":["5c86224028e3#0"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"No retrieved passage compares weight loss outcomes in older adults between intermittent fasting and continuous calorie restriction.","cited_pids":[]},{"cid":"c9","text":"No conclusion about the relative effectiveness of the two approaches can be drawn from the retrieved evidence.","cited_pids":[]},{"cid":"c10","text":"A targeted search of randomized trials in older populations would be needed to answer the question.","cited_pids":[]}]}
